meta.about: The case lens's third held-out lines (case-lens-2, 2026-10-30, seed 20261030): 110 content lines drawn at random (none of the other sets'), one word with a nominal reading in each, the words with a case in their line labelled by hand before the lens ran on them (89; the 21 adverbs, verbs, interjections and spoken hours left out), and run once to measure (test/case-lens-eval.ts heldout3): the accuracy on lines the lens has never been tuned on. Machine-labelled (Claude): wants a native speaker's check.
